subs.name: Cumprimentos e cortesia
subs.desc: Palavras para cumprimentar e ser educado: hello, please, thank you, sorry, excuse me. Ex.: "Thank you very much."
subs.pattern: \b(?P<w>hello|hi|goodbye|bye|please|thanks|thank(?= you\b)|sorry|excuse(?= me\b)|welcome|pardon|(?:(?<=^good )|(?<=\bsay good )|(?<=\bsaid good )|(?<=\bsays good )|(?<=\bsaying good ))(?:morning|afternoon|evening|night))\b

subs.name: Números
subs.desc: Os números por extenso: two, three, ten, twenty, hundred, thousand. Ex.: "I have three brothers."

subs.name: Cores
subs.desc: As cores: red, blue, green, yellow, black, white... Em inglês o adjetivo vem antes do substantivo: "a red car".
subs.exclude: (?-i:\b(?:Black|White|Brown|Green|Grey|Gray)\b(?<!^Black)(?<!^White)(?<!^Brown)(?<!^Green))|\boranges\b|\b(?:an|this|that|the|one|my|your|his|her) orange\b(?!\s+(?:shirt|dress|car|hat|cat|light|color|colour|paint|wall|door|t-shirt|sweater|jacket|ball|hair|sky|flowers?))|\bwhite lie|\bblack market|\bfeel(?:s|ing)? blue|\bout of the blue|\bblue moon

subs.name: Dias, meses e estações
subs.desc: Dias da semana, meses e estações. Em inglês dias e meses têm letra maiúscula: "on Monday", "in October", "in summer".

subs.name: Família
subs.desc: Membros da família: mother, father, brother, sister, son, daughter, wife, husband, uncle, aunt...

subs.name: Corpo humano
subs.desc: Partes do corpo: head, eyes, nose, mouth, hand, arm, leg, foot... Atenção: tooth → teeth, foot → feet.
subs.exclude: \b(?:the|a) (?:back (?:of|door|seat|yard|row|room)|head (?:of|office|teacher|start)|hand(?:s)? (?:of|over)|face of|foot of|arms (?:race|dealer))\b|\bon the other hand|\bthe right hand man|\bat the (?:back|head)\b|\bin the back\b|\b(?:a|the) (?:right|left) (?:hand|foot|arm|leg|eye|ear)? ?(?:turn|side)\b|\bback (?:to|home|up|down|in|out|on|then)\b|\bthe back\b(?! subs.name: Roupas
subs.desc: Peças de roupa: shirt, dress, pants, jacket, coat, shoes, hat... Note que pants, jeans e shorts são sempre plurais.

subs.name: Animais
subs.desc: Animais: dog, cat, horse, bird, fish, cow, mouse... Plurais irregulares: mouse → mice, wolf → wolves; sheep, fish e deer não mudam.
subs.exclude: \b(?:bear(?:s)? (?:with|in mind|the|it|this|that|a|any|no|fruit|witness|responsibility)|can't bear|cannot bear|couldn't bear|to bear|duck(?:s|ed)? subs.name: Comidas e bebidas
subs.desc: Comidas, bebidas e refeições: bread, rice, meat, milk, coffee, water, breakfast, lunch, dinner...
subs.exclude: \bwater(?:s|ed|ing)? (?:the|my|your|his|her|our|their|these|those|it|them|plants?|flowers?)\b|\b(?:to|will|please|i'll|don't|forgot to) water\b|\bbread(?:ed)? crumbs?\b|\bpiece of cake\b|\bcake(?:d)? (?:with|in)\b|\bsalt (?:water|shaker)\b|\bthe apple of\b|(?-i:\bApple\b)|\bbeans? (?:about|out)\b|\bfull of beans\b|\bspill the beans\b|\bcoffee (?:shop|table|cup|maker|machine|break|pot|beans|house)\b|\btea(?:cup|pot| party| set| bag)\b|\b(?:lunch|dinner|breakfast) (?:break|time|table|party|hour|box|menu|plate|bill)\b|\bpepper spray\b|\bwater (?:polo|bottle|pipe|pressure|supply|level|heater|ski)\b|\bwine (?:glass|bottle|cellar|list)\b|\bbeer (?:can|bottle|glass|belly)\b|\bfruit(?:ful|less)\b|\bhoney(?:moon)?\b(?=,|\?|!)|\bmy honey\b|\b(?:orange|lemon) (?:juice|tree|peel)\b|\bsugar(?:ed|-coat)

subs.name: Palavras interrogativas
subs.desc: Para fazer perguntas: who (quem), what (o que/qual), where (onde), when (quando), why (por que), how (como), which (qual), whose (de quem). Ex.: "Where do you live?"

subs.name: Lugares da cidade
subs.desc: Lugares da cidade: school, hospital, bank, station, airport, library, park, restaurant... Ex.: "Where is the station?"

subs.name: Profissões
subs.desc: Profissões: doctor, teacher, nurse, lawyer, engineer, student... Em inglês usa-se "a/an" antes da profissão: "She is a doctor."

subs.name: Adjetivos opostos
subs.desc: Adjetivos e seus opostos: big ↔ small, hot ↔ cold, old ↔ new/young, cheap ↔ expensive, easy ↔ difficult...
subs.exclude: \b(?:my|your|his|her|our|their|its) right\b|\bbe long\s*[.!?]|\bnew (?:York|Year|Zealand|Jersey|Orleans|Mexico|Delhi|Hampshire|England)\b|\b(?:all right|right now|right here|right there|right away|that's right|is that right|the right (?:to|thing|side|hand|way|answer|person|direction|moment)|on the right|to the right|turn right|pretty (?:much|well|soon|good|bad|big|old|cold|hot|sure|hard|easy|expensive|cheap|busy|quiet|tired|sick|happy|sad|close)|a little|the little|little by little|as (?:good|soon|long|well|fast|quick|early|late) as|for good|in short|short for|the old days|the poor|the rich|the young|the old\b(?! \w)|the late \w+|a long (?:time|way)|too bad|so long|the long run|too late|it's late|true (?:story|love)|come true|light (?:up|on|off|the))\b|\bpretty\s+(?!girl|woman|dress|face|flowers?|house|picture|garden|name|eyes|hat|smile)\w+

subs.name: Artigos: a, an, the
subs.desc: "a" antes de som de consoante, "an" antes de som de vogal (an apple, an hour); "the" quando a coisa é específica. Profissões levam artigo: "She is a nurse."

subs.name: Verbo to be
subs.desc: Presente: I am, he/she/it is, you/we/they are. Passado: I/he/she/it was, you/we/they were. Ex.: "They are here." / "She was tired."
subs.exclude: \b(?:if|wish|as if|as though|even if)\s+(?:I|he|she|it|Tom|Mary)\s+(?:\w+\s+)?were\b|\bwere (?:I|he|she|it|Tom) to\b|\b(?:a|the|any|no|some)\s+\w+\s+(?:of|from)\s+\w+\s+(?:is|are|was|were)\b|\b(?:neither|either|none|one) of\b|\b(?:what|who|where|which|how many|how much)\s+(?:is|are|was|were)\b|\b(?:and|or|nor)\s+\w+\s+(?:is|are|was|were)\b|\b(?:number|majority|lot|bunch|group|couple|pair|family|team|police|staff|class|people|news|data|series|crowd)\s+(?:\w+\s+)?(?:is|are|was|were)\b|\bthere(?:'s| is| are| was| were)\b

subs.name: There is / there are
subs.desc: "Há/tem": there is + singular, there are + plural; no passado, there was / there were. Ex.: "There are two cats." / "There was a problem."
subs.pattern: (?:(?<=\bthere )|(?<=^)(?=\w+ there\b)|(?<=[,;] )(?=\w+ there\b)|(?<=\bwhy )(?=\w+ there\b)|(?<=\bhow )(?=\w+ there\b)|(?<=\bwhat )(?=\w+ there\b)|(?<=\bwhere )(?=\w+ there\b)|(?<=\bwhen )(?=\w+ there\b))(?P<w>is|are|was|were)\b

subs.name: Presente simples: -s
subs.desc: No presente simples, he/she/it leva -s no verbo: "She works", "He goes", "Tom has". Com I/you/we/they, sem -s: "They work". Na negativa e na pergunta o -s vai para o auxiliar: "She doesn't work".

(?:father|mother|brother|sister|wife|husband|son|daughter|friend|dog|cat|boss|uncle|aunt|teacher)|His (?:father|mother|brother|sister|wife|son|daughter|friend|dog)|Her subs.name: Do, does, did
subs.desc: Auxiliares de perguntas e negativas: do (I/you/we/they), does (he/she/it), did (passado, todas as pessoas). Ex.: "Does she work?" / "I didn't see it."

subs.name: Possessivos: his, her...
subs.desc: O possessivo concorda com o DONO, não com a coisa: his (dele), her (dela), their (deles/delas), its (de coisa/animal). Ex.: "Tom loves his mother." / "Mary loves her father."

subs.name: In, on, at
subs.desc: Tempo: at + horas (at six), on + dias e datas (on Monday), in + meses, anos, estações e partes do dia (in May, in the morning). Lugar: at home/work, on the table/floor/bus, in + cidade/país (in Boston).
subs.pattern: (?-i:\b(?P<w>[Ii]n|[Oo]n|[Aa]t)\b)(?=\s+(?:(?:about\s+)?(?:one|two|three|four|five|six|seven|eight|nine|ten|eleven|twelve)(?:\s+o'clock|\s+thirty|\s+fifteen|\s+forty-five)?(?!\s+(?:years?|months?|weeks?|days?|hours?|minutes?|seconds?|times?|of|people|men|dollars|percent))\b|noon\b|midnight\b|night\b|dawn\b|home\b|work\b|least\b|first\b(?!\s+(?:sight|glance))|once\b|the subs.name: Some ou any
subs.desc: "some" (e something, someone, somewhere) em frases afirmativas; "any" (anything, anyone, anywhere) em frases negativas. Ex.: "I have some money." / "I don't have any money."

subs.name: Passado irregular
subs.desc: Muitos verbos comuns têm passado irregular: go → went, see → saw, eat → ate, buy → bought, think → thought. Ex.: "I went to Boston yesterday."
subs.exclude: \b(?:have|has|had|haven't|hasn't|hadn't|'ve|'d|having)\b|\bleft (?:hand|side|arm|leg|foot|eye|ear|turn|wing|lane)\b|\b(?:on|to|the|my|your|his|her) left\b|\bleft over\b|\bturn(?:ed)? left\b|\bthere's \w+ left\b|\b(?:anything|nothing|something|much|none|any|some|everything|all|one|two|three|few|little|those) left\b|\b(?:\w+) left\?|\bmade (?:of|in|from|by|for)\b|\bfelt (?:pen|tip|hat)\b|\bbit (?:of|more|less|too|late|early|tired|better|worse|different|nervous)\b|\b(?:a|the|little) bit\b|\bwon't\b(?=.*\bwon\b)|\bbuilt-in\b|\blost (?:and found|cause)\b|\bfound(?:ed|ation)\b|\bsaid (?:that )?(?:he|she|they|I|you|we|Tom|Mary) (?:was|were|is|are|would|will|had|has)\b|\b(?:if|wish|as if|as though|suppose|supposing)\b|\bkept (?:\w+ )?(?:-ing)\b

subs.name: Particípio: have seen
subs.desc: Depois de have/has/had vem o particípio, não o passado: "I have seen" (não "have saw"), "She has gone", "We had eaten". Muitos são irregulares: saw → seen, went → gone, did → done.

subs.name: Comparativos e superlativos
subs.desc: Comparativo + than: "bigger than", "more expensive than". Superlativo com the: "the biggest", "the most expensive". Irregulares: good → better → best, bad → worse → worst.
subs.exclude: \bmore and more\b|\bmore than (?:a|one|two|three|\w+ (?:years|days|hours|times|people|dollars))\b|\bthe most\b(?=\s+(?:people|of|important to))|\b(?:had|'d) better\b|\bat (?:the )?(?:best|worst|most|latest|least)\b|\bthe best (?:of|part)\b|\b(?:all|for) the best\b|\b(?:do|did|does|doing) (?:my|his|her|your|our|their) best\b|\bthe (?:latest|greatest)\b(?=\s+(?:news|thing))|\bno (?:better|longer|more) than\b|\brather than\b|\b(?:know|knew|knows|known) better\b|\bother than\b|\bthan (?:ever|usual|expected|I thought)\b(?=.*\b(?:better|worse)\b)

subs.name: Make ou do
subs.desc: "make" = criar/produzir algo (make a cake, make a mistake, make money, make a decision, make noise); "do" = realizar tarefas e atividades (do homework, do the dishes, do your best, do a favor).
